details: The next action should have a purpose

Build a safe base and an active coven, then use meaningful battles, Incantations and Hexes to progress toward the great ritual. Territory is a means to finance and protect that work, not the finish line.
No false sequencing

Hex unlock quests, empowerment research, the landmark and provincial administration are distinct progress systems. The queue is a practical order of attention, not an assertion that each item unlocks the next.

details: Three layers of craft

The base Incantation has a purpose; trinkets customise its effects; the resulting item must be applied to a valid prebattle target. Choose by the final tooltip, not simply the race that supplied a trinket.
Good default packages

For a vulnerable monster: a compatible defensive blessing. For an expensive shooting group: a compatible missile-support blessing. Against a dangerous large attacker: a curse that weakens or slows it, then focus suitable anti-large damage. Exact combinations depend on your currently unlocked trinkets.
Not the VCO ingredient hunt

Itxi Grubs, Jungle Lotus Leaves and Coatl Feathers in Toil & Trouble are route-objective groups. Do not assume crafting a similarly named ingredient or gaining a generic race trinket replaces the settlement objective.

hexes.label: Hexes
hexes.title: Five campaign tools, then the great ritual
hexes.intro: Unlock order is progression; choosing where and when to cast is the strategy.

steps.short: Purification Chant: prepare the next operation

steps.title: Coven’s Cursemark: pin the threat
steps.short: Coven’s Cursemark: pin the threat
steps.note: Use movement/stance disruption before the pursuit or attack. Confirm the affected force and duration.

steps.short: Jinxed Land: move an army via a magical forest
steps.note: Inspect a legal destination, arrival risk and the remaining journey. Do not assume it teleports to any settlement.

steps.title: Bewitching Lure: fund a real expedition
steps.short: Bewitching Lure: fund a real expedition
steps.note: Target worthwhile income rather than an empty ruin. Treat the live duration and return as temporary support.

steps.title: Recreant Spirit: pressure a useful enemy region
steps.short: Recreant Spirit: pressure a useful enemy region
steps.note: Use the disruption to support your own operation. Do not assume spawned forces are permanent recruitable troops.

steps.title: Malediction of Ruin: follow the live final mission
steps.short: Malediction of Ruin: follow the live final mission
steps.note: Route I’s public code checks its named set-piece battle. Keep final-battle victory, a possible map cast and the actual route award separate.

details: Purification Chant · cleanse and cure

Clear the corrupt staging region or cure a plague before it compromises the next operation. Use it where the consequence matters, not merely on the nearest patch of corruption. Devotion and corruption are separate. Cleansing does not itself refill the provincial invocation budget.
Coven’s Cursemark · pin and pursue

Cripple a threatening army’s ability to escape or exploit its stances, then make the planned interception. Check the live duration and affected army. It is not a battle spell and does not mean every army in the province is immobilised.
Jinxed Land · forest transit or banishment

Use the magical-forest destinations as campaign transport. Scout the arrival area, access permissions and the distance still left to your target. Not arbitrary city-to-city teleportation. Banishing a required final enemy may lengthen the victory chase; the guide does not assume every target or destination is always valid.
Bewitching Lure · temporary expedition income

Choose a worthwhile developed settlement and use the return to fund the next operation or defensive response. Inspect live income, duration and eligibility. Do not treat an estimated return as permanent ordinary tax income.
Recreant Spirit · regional disruption

Create pressure on the enemy’s region at a time your own army can exploit it. Do not budget the effect as a permanent controllable army, or assume its independent actions satisfy your VCO requirements.
A banishment can postpone the problem
Jinxed Land can be a strong emergency tool. On The New Frontier, sending a required enemy’s last army far away may create a very long chase. Prefer pinning and eliminating a finish-line target.
Do not spend merely to animate a counter

Useful casts and Incantations should serve the campaign. Where a spending gate is close, confirm the real credit per action before calculating how many more casts or crafts are needed. Research expenditure is not assumed to count.
Empowerment order follows use

For a travelling expedition, inspect Jinxed Land’s upgrade early; for a plague or corruption problem, prefer improved Purification; for a pursuit-heavy war, improve the pinning tool. Read each live research effect rather than treating all empowerments as mandatory.

steps.short: Never let neglect reach −100

details: A common trap

A province at 90 becomes 40 after a 50-cost invocation. The action can be legal while still removing its climate protection. Weigh the before-and-after balance before spending from a high-Devotion province.
Army and settlement versions differ
The rework has both types. A settlement’s local storm or defence effect is not automatically carried by a travelling army. Read the actual version selected.
Ursun does not buff all “bear-looking” units

The official army example includes movement, an ability and additional damage for War Bear Riders / Elemental Bears. Do not attribute its unit-specific damage to Feral Bears, spiders, Things or Incarnates.

details: Low-maintenance routine
Review the panel after a support tier or major construction milestone, not after every movement order. A sensible boon and a stable realm beat frequent rearrangement for tiny gains.
Army and faction scope
Prefer permanent bonuses for the units and provinces that will actually use them. A cavalry-specific boon does not suddenly improve all forest beasts.
Modern administration supersedes launch advice

Ostankya has Court & Orthodoxy and provincial Devotion under the rework. Old pages saying she has no such mechanics are not used for present strategy. Blue skills that retain older terminology should be read for their live effect.

details: Do not confuse unlock conditions and VCO objectives
Owning or allying with a Kislev capital-holder is a roster consideration, not a requirement of the three published Immortal Empires routes.
Training is now more predictable

The reworked Ice Court offers a shorter sequence with more trait choices. When you actually choose to recruit a trained caster, build around the army’s job rather than continually rerolling characters. None of the core templates requires Frost Maiden training.
Witch-lore, spell access and personal spells are separate questions

The lore paths on the Armies & skills page describe a caster’s spell tree; a route’s default lore is a reference choice, not a confirmation that a recruited caster already has those spells. A Hag develops a repeatable spell package from the selected lore, and a second caster complements Ostankya’s Hags toolkit rather than carrying her personal spells or doubling the shared Winds budget. Availability is unverified: check the live skill and recruitment panels before assuming a package.
